summary: MetalKit is Apple's Metal helper layer: a view that owns a drawable loop (MTKView), a texture loader, and Model I/O mesh wrappers. BifrOSt has a GPU presenter with a Metal-shaped internal API (device, drawables, one render pass per present) on GLES, but no app-facing SDK equivalent of any MetalKit class, and no mesh handling.

features.note: Presenter is internal to the shell. SDK views are retained CPU views; no app-facing GPU render view or per-frame draw delegate
GBM and EGL drawables exist in the system layer; apps get no device or drawable API

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (decode, PNG and JPEG); springboard/src/gpu/mod.rs (upload, line 352)
features.note: Images decode to RGBA on the CPU and upload to GLES. No app-facing GPU texture object, no asynchronous load, no asset catalog lookup, no texture options

features.feature: Model I/O mesh handling (MTKMesh, MTKSubmesh, MTKMeshBuffer, allocator)
features.note: No mesh, vertex-descriptor or index-buffer type outside the shell's internal 2D batch (springboard/src/gpu/batch.rs, a fixed 64-byte quad vertex)

features.apple: (no direct MetalKit class; Metal draw calls)
features.note: Internal batching of shell primitives into one vertex list per frame. Not exposed to apps

features.apple: Conversion Functions (Metal and Model I/O vertex layouts), Model Errors
features.note: Depends on Model I/O, which BifrOSt does not have

gaps: No app-facing GPU view with a per-frame delegate (MTKView and MTKViewDelegate equivalent) in springboard/sdk/src/
No app-facing GPU texture loader (MTKTextureLoader equivalent); springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs decodes on the CPU only
No mesh container or mesh loading path (MTKMesh, MTKSubmesh equivalent); nothing under springboard/sdk/src/ or springboard/render/src/
Presenter (springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs) is shell-internal; its Metal-shaped API has no SDK binding
The GPU stack is GLES on GBM and EGL, not Metal; a Metal-shaped API is only a design note in docs/gpu-first.md
